comparison.objective: Untangle two crossed cables, then insert their plugs into color-matched dock ports.
comparison.physical_skill: Cable topology manipulation followed by two connector insertions.
comparison.success_condition: Cables no longer cross, plugs occupy matching ports, and both plugs are released; numeric tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Cable untangling and connector insertion are meaningfully different from stabilized impact tooling, controlled fracture, and containment of four loose tangs.
